title: A Semi-Analytical Inference Framework for Structural Causal Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structural Causal Models (SCMs) provide a principled framework for observational, interventional, and counterfactual reasoning, all of which rely on probabilistic inference. Existing frameworks either transform SCMs into alternative tractable representations or rely on approximate inference with expressive generative models. We instead perform inference using a message passing scheme directly on the SCM by representing structural mechanisms and probability densities in a common finite-dimensional function space. Forward propagation combines a numerical realization of the Law of the Unconscious Statistician, while propagated densities are recovered by spline projection from LOTUS moments. The same representation naturally yields backward message passing for conditioning, providing a unified framework for causal inference. Using tensor-product B-spline bases, the resulting algorithm expresses inference through numerical quadrature and line

translated_title: 结构因果模型的半解析推理框架
translated_abstract: 结构因果模型为观察性、干预性和反事实推理提供了一个原则性框架，而这些推理都依赖于概率推断。现有框架要么将结构因果模型转换为其他可处理的表示形式，要么依赖具有强表达能力的生成模型进行近似推断。我们则采用消息传递方案直接在结构因果模型上执行推断，方法是将结构机制和概率密度表示在一个共同的有限维函数空间中。前向传播结合了无意识统计学家定律（LOTUS）的数值实现，而传播后的密度则通过样条投影从LOTUS矩中恢复。相同的表示自然地产生了用于条件化的后向消息传递，为因果推断提供了一个统一框架。利用张量积B样条基，所得到的算法通过数值求积和线性（原文截断）来表达推断。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种半解析推理框架，通过在共同的有限维函数空间中用B样条基表示结构机制和概率密度，直接在结构因果模型上执行前向和后向消息传递，为观察性、干预性和反事实的因果推断提供了统一框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semi-analytical inference framework that performs forward and backward message passing directly on Structural Causal Models by representing structural mechanisms and probability densities in a common finite-dimensional B-spline function space, providing a unified framework for observational, interventional, and counterfactual causal inference.
